title: The journal closes its books as event sourcing practises it: one opening entry per standing item, carrying its balance forward, and nothing of the closed period
situation: Decision 0315 realized closing the books as one close entry holding every standing item and the id of every entry the period ended, with every id each context had held, each concept's first version and how each reference by name bound, growing with each close. The architect found it departs from the practice, which opens the new period with an entry per account carrying its balance forward, in the journal's own grain of one entry per change, and carries nothing of the closed period into the new one.
decision: (1) The concepts capability keeps the verb close, of effect closes, taking nothing; the command and the tool built from its explanation offer it to everyone. (2) A close writes, at one moment, one opening entry per current version of each standing item, minted in the order the readings list them: the purpose; each context; each live concept, context by context; each standing decision; then removes every other entry file, an earlier close's openings included. An opening entry is an entry of its item's own kind, the first of its item in the new period, stamped with the close's moment and who closed, superseding nothing, and carrying broughtForward, the full sha of the commit at HEAD that holds the closed period. The purpose opens with its current statement and reason; a context with its name, current subject, relation and reason, and identity, the context's identity, which an account keeps across periods as its number; a live concept as a define with its context, name, current wording, built-from and reason; a standing decision as a decide with its name, context, title, situation, decision and consequences, accepted where it is accepted, else open, supersedes null, and its governing kind where one is recorded. Competing current versions open each as an entry of its own, so they still compete. A retired concept, a superseded or deprecated decision, an acceptance, a classification and a cut's efficiency figures are not carried: they stay in the closed period. No entry of kind close exists. (3) Every reading reads the entries the directory holds, and only those: nothing is folded in and nothing excluded. A context's identity is the identity its earliest entry carries, else that entry's id; a journal owns a delivered context whose identity is one of its contexts'. The history readings name, as booksClosed, the latest opening: its moment, who closed and the commit holding the closed period; and mark each opening entry they list as brought forward from that commit. (4) An entry joined from a line of work that branched before a close is read as recorded: a version superseding versions the journal does not hold leaves its item's opening current beside it, so the two compete until a later version settles them; an acceptance, deprecation or supersession naming a decision's entry the journal does not hold binds by the decision's name where one decision has it. (5) A close refuses, changing nothing, where the journal's directory differs from HEAD in anything, an ignored file included; where there is no commit; where it read past entries of a newer runtime; where the journal holds no entry; and where it holds nothing but opening entries; where writing the openings or removing the period's files fails, it restores the directory from HEAD and removes the openings it wrote, leaving the journal as it was. (6) Every other verb only appends, and no verb edits an entry. (7) The leakage reading compares a version with the versions it replaces that the journal holds; an opening replaces none.
consequences: Supersedes 0315. The closed period, its history included, is read from version control at the commit its openings name; nothing about it grows from close to close. A concept retired before a close returns by define. One builder; review Ask.
